CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.clear_daily_report_signatures_on_workers()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.daily_reports set representative_signature_json=null, representative_signer_name=null,
    supervisor_signature_json=null, supervisor_signer_name=null
  where id=coalesce(new.report_id, old.report_id) and status='draft';
  return coalesce(new,old);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.guard_report_metadata()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if current_user<>'postgres' and ((tg_op='INSERT' and (new.company_allowance_selections is not null or new.company_allowance_legacy_labels is not null))
 or (tg_op='UPDATE' and (new.company_allowance_selections is distinct from old.company_allowance_selections
  or new.company_allowance_legacy_labels is distinct from old.company_allowance_legacy_labels))) then
  raise exception 'server-validated company allowance selections required' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return new;
end $function$
